issues: navigator.clipboard.writeText() rejection is not caught → surfaces as 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay in dev mode when clipboard permission is unavailable (e.g., insecure context or headless). Toast still shows 'Copied' but the promise rejection is unhandled. Wrap in try/catch or .catch(() => {}). Non-blocking in production.

value_engine_service.calculate() uses safe coercion (n helper) and guards divide-by-zero on profit_per_customer/close_rate — solid.
